course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Metroklean LLC, a hazardous waste soil cleaning company, borrowed \$2.5 million for 5 years to finance start-up costs for anew project involving site reclamation, The company expects to earn a real rate of return of 20% per year. The average inflation rate is 5 % per year.
i) Determine the capital recovery required each year with inflation considered.
ii) Determine the capital recovery if the company is satisfied with accumulating \$2.5 million at the end of the 5 years with inflation considered.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
